architecture.reason: A real compiled atom has a 486-byte control capsule and a 279-byte subject capsule. Combining them would exceed the 512-byte work-unit ceiling, so they are released as two separately gated post-Goal phases.
architecture.work_unit: ONE FRESH TEST TAKER, ONE NATIVE GOAL, ONE CONTROL CAPSULE, ONE SUBJECT CAPSULE, ONE RESULT

child_contract.use: Retain the control capsule from the first wait. Apply it to the subject capsule returned by the second wait. Produce only the bounded result, complete the same Goal, and do not call any other tool.

custody.control_gate: The parent may create control.stage only after raw ACTIVE, exact control-wait call, and ready_control.json are reopened and bound. It then normalizes 0444, verifies exact bytes and SHA-256, atomically renames to control.txt, and fsyncs the mailbox directory.
custody.predeclaration: Binds the exact source cell, atom identity, Goal objective, route, requested model/effort, control and subject file identities, expected result hash, waiter identity, task path, and all absence predicates without containing control or subject bytes.
custody.subject_gate: The parent may create subject.stage only after the exact second wait call and ready_subject.json are reopened and bound. control.txt must remain exact; subject.stage and subject.txt were absent through that gate. Publication is 0444, verified, atomic, and directory-fsynced.
custody.waiter: One immutable phase-aware waiter accepts exactly PHASE and GOAL_THREAD_ID. Each phase creates one O_EXCL 0444 ready receipt, fsyncs it and the directory, waits only for its matching immutable capsule, reopens exact bytes, and writes that capsule once to stdout.

failure_rules: Any control or subject content present before its corresponding gate consumes the case
Any Goal, task, route, phase, command, workdir, thread, source-cell, capsule, or result mismatch consumes the case
Any extra tool, retry, relaunch, replacement, resend, best-of, reuse, timeout continuation, or salvage consumes the case
A correct semantic result cannot offset a lifecycle, custody, ordering, or freshness failure
A consumed capability or canary authorizes no replacement under the same family
nonclaims: The mechanically successful one-phase capability proved Goal-before-subject blocking transport only; it did not prove a real compiled two-capsule atom.
The failed advisory review remains a failure and contributes no authority.
Requested route is not effective-platform model attestation.
Static plan, architecture, or capability evidence is zero qualification credit.
The external OMP lane remains frozen and out of scope.
